usage: The word '驚' (geng1) can be used as an adjective to describe the feeling of being afraid or scared.
It can also function as a verb meaning 'to be afraid' or 'to scare'.
'驚' often appears before the subject or object to express the cause or reason for fear.
It can be combined with other words to express degrees or types of fear, such as '好驚' (very scared).
In casual speech, '驚' is commonly used to warn or express surprise indirectly.
